findings: final_manager invokes final_aux_worker.py for SAM and config_worker.py for DiffV2IR.

SAM uses SamAutomaticMaskGenerator.generate(rgb) over the current full RGB frame; all predicted segmentations are unioned. No GT boxes or GT masks are passed as SAM prompts in the active implementation.
The production plan reads annotation tables for frame IDs, RGB paths and split membership; annotation boxes are not passed to image generation.
DiffV2IR conditioning uses the current RGB image, automatic SAM union and fixed caption; the output is grayscale PNG.
The fixed caption is there are goldfish swimming in the fish tank, with seed 20261101 and M3FD EMA weights.
limitations: This code/metadata audit is not an independent rerun of all 48070 historical generation jobs.
Test-sequence generation probes and historical tracker tuning were used previously; downstream comparison is not a blind benchmark.
The old archived legacy IR has a separate provenance and is not relabelled as the audited causal cache or physical sensor data.
